description_en: Queries the recoverable time range of a sandbox instance
description_zh: 查看沙箱实例的可恢复时间范围
name: DescribeSandboxRecoveryTime

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup plan. You can call the DescribeBackupPlanList (https://api.aliyun.com/document/Dbs/2019-03-06/DescribeBackupPlanList) operation to obtain this parameter. When you specify the backup plan ID, you must remove the dbs prefix. Otherwise, the call fails.

If your instance is an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance, use the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193091.html feature to automatically add the RDS instance to DBS and obtain the backup plan ID
parameters.help_zh:
备份计划ID，您可以通过DescribeBackupPlanList (https://api.aliyun.com/document/Dbs/2019-03-06/DescribeBackupPlanList)接口获取该参数。获取到的备份计划ID传入时，必须去掉前缀dbs，否则将调用失败。

若您的实例为RDS MySQL，请通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193091.html功能，将RDS自动添加至DBS中，即可获取备份计划ID
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

BackupPlanId.description_en: The backup plan of the sandbox instance

RecoveryBeginTime.description_en: The start time of the recoverable time range, in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
RecoveryBeginTime.description_zh: 可恢复的开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

RecoveryEndTime.description_en: The end time of the recoverable time range, in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
RecoveryEndTime.description_zh: 可恢复的截止时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
